Ravi Shah: Heads-up: customers asking for predictable commit w/ cheaper baseline. Proposed pilot: 10% commit headroom + optional token addon. Need trade-off analysis.
Nora Liu: Can we run cost parity sims for AcmePay traces? If tokens cost <= 0.4x on average it's attractive.
Caleb Wright: We should factor in quantized fallback too. Reduce severity by routing non-critical requests to low-quant variant under pressure.
Mei Zhang: UX: console should show projected token burn if projected traffic spikes. Billing-bot: Created BILL-9001 for pricing model input.
Ravi Shah: Action: Nora run sims, Caleb prototype fallback, Mei draft console panel. Bring to Friday planning.
